examples.title: A Qwen2.5 model among Qwen2.5 models
points: Training model in this fold. Predictions only.
Nearest neighbour: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, also built on Qwen2.5.
5 of the 10 nearest are Qwen2.5 instruct models: 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, Coder-7B, 7B-Instruct.
The 10 neighbours range from 0.5B to 9B parameters.

examples.title: A merge next to models from its publisher
points: A 13B Llama-2 merge.
Held out with every other model from its publisher. The folds group models by publisher.
6 of its 10 nearest neighbours come from that publisher. The other 4 are Llama-family role-play, uncensored or instruction fine-tunes.
Release date and hedging: predictions close to the true values.
Size: predicted about 10B, true 13B. Answer length is underestimated.
No Open LLM Leaderboard v2 score, so that row shows a prediction only.

examples.title: An uncensored fine-tune next to its 7B sibling
points: The 260 paper models include no abliterated model. This is the closest kind in the set: a Llama-family fine-tune released as uncensored.
Training model in this fold. Predictions only.
Neighbours include Wizard-Vicuna-7B-Uncensored and two other uncensored fine-tunes, Uncensored-Frank 7B and 13B.
Refusal, length and hedging: the author responses report that the label's own formula, computed from the answers, beats the embedding (general response, row 4).
The refusal prediction here only illustrates the head.

examples.title: A held-out preference-tuned model finds its base model
points: Held out. The encoder and heads never saw it.
Placed from its answers alone (bits, question text, answer text), the same way an upload is.
Nearest neighbour, by a clear margin: gemma-2-9b-it, the model it was preference-tuned from.
Release date and base vs chat: predictions match the true labels.
Size: predicted about 5B, true 9B.
Answer length and hedging are overestimated.

examples.title: A model with no relatives in the set
points: Held out. The only SmolLM model among the 260.
Nearest neighbours: 7B to 13B Llama and Mistral chat fine-tunes from 2023, with lower similarities than in the other examples.
The heads miss. They predict a model several times larger, released earlier.
Transfer to specialized fine-tunes and atypical models remains untested (author responses).
